hook.title: 4 things that happened while you were scrolling.

stories.headline: GTA 6 is 9 days away.
stories.body: Rockstar still has it locked for <mark>November 19</mark> on <mark>PS5 and Xbox Series X|S</mark>. The game has already been <mark>delayed twice</mark>, first from 2025, then from May 2026. A <mark>PC version</mark> is expected later but isn't confirmed. Right now: <mark>no new delay</mark>.

stories.headline: Google is switching off AI for students.
stories.body: <mark>Gemini will be off by default</mark> on K-12 school accounts until the school turns it on. The catch: Google says Search now runs on AI, so schools that keep AI off <mark>lose Google Search too</mark>. It follows <mark>pushback from parents' groups and senators</mark>. Exact timing <mark>isn't set yet</mark>.

stories.headline: A robot built something in space. Alone.
stories.body: Caltech's <mark>ASTRA</mark> robot, part of a <mark>DARPA</mark> program, put together a <mark>1.4-meter ring</mark> in orbit and unfolded a reflective mesh, with <mark>no astronauts</mark> involved. It's small, but it's a first. The goal: build <mark>huge antennas and telescopes</mark> in space instead of cramming them into rockets.

stories.headline: Hubble could fall back to Earth in ~7 years.
stories.body: The 36-year-old telescope has <mark>no engine</mark> and its orbit is slowly sinking. Without help it could <mark>re-enter around 2033–34</mark>. NASA is now asking companies how they'd <mark>boost it higher or service it</mark>. Ideas are due <mark>Nov 30</mark>, but <mark>nothing is funded yet</mark>.
